Issued 10 November 1928, 5 P.M. E.S.T.
Forecast: Tomorrow: Cloudy; light variable wind. The low sky holds the chimney smoke. Expected high about 41 degrees.
Valid 11 November 1928, 6 A.M. to 11 November 1928, 6 P.M. E.S.T.

The Borough Record / Saturday 10 November 1928
Count of Tuesday's returns still in dispute in four counties
Wire tally and paper tally differ by 1,912 votes; Hoover's margin unaffected, Board says
Counting people twice is a curious way of failing to hear them once. That is a comment on the report, not a second tally.
